alerts.text: No round has started since yesterday's report, so nothing new was applied to my_team.json (24 Nov Variation A stays). R15 trades lock Thursday 3 Dec 19:30 Athens.

Kamenjas hurt his knee in R14 (helped off before half-time, came back, 15' and 5 PIR), and new signing Perrin had 20 PIR in his debut. I cut his expected PIR from 17 to 14.5 and took the armband off him: Vezenkov is captain in all three variations.
Prices are still R14's (the site's R15 price page isn't out). All variations keep 0.8+ in the bank; re-import app prices once the game updates.

Your 2-per-game rule costs about 5 points of probability this round (25% vs 29%), because Olympiacos–ASVEL is the round's most lopsided game. A and B keep it; C drops it. Write 'per-game rule off' in inbox/team.md if it was only for R14.

FIBA window: Vezenkov (Bulgaria v Denmark, 26 Nov), Procida (Italy, 29 Nov in Belgrade), Kamenjas (Bosnia, 26 and 29 Nov, after the knee knock). Hifi withdrew from France's squad to rest. The daily runs will re-check before Thursday.

review: R14 (scorecard): Variation A scored 87.8 against 173 predicted (B 90.5, C 88.2); the scorecard uses the pre-round lineup, so with last night's swaps (Vezenkov captain, Ward in) it was nearer 110. Captain Hifi 16 vs best Vezenkov 23. Three things sank it: Navarro (RED) −20 after Zvezda lost 84–108 at home, Carter 0, and Kamenjas' knee knock (5 PIR). I backed Navarro's words and a coach on a home favourite before a FIBA break; lesson kept from yesterday: no coach on a team in a slump, whatever the press conference says. Projections: stars (15+) were 3.3 PIR under projection, cheap players 1.7 over, and the biggest upside misses were Cory Joseph (31 vs 7.8) and Grigonis (26 vs 8.9): role jumps again, so both are in today's plans. Two rounds in a row the best captain was the Olympiacos home star (Vezenkov), so the armband goes to him by default this round. Research: 80 searches, 40 pages read, 7 players unverified (Hifi's last LNB game, Ward, Diop, Grigonis, Walker, Abalde, Sleva domestic lines).
